items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1960-11-30
items.q: Lloyd and I worked together and did a recording for the Benny Goodman tour.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. That's Lloyd Glenn, pianist. Did you know him later on? I mean, did you see him out in California? Yeah, I saw Lloyd since I... Lloyd and I worked together and did a recording for the Benny Goodman tour. Lloyd, Ray Callen and all that.
I guess that's all there is to pass. Accepting this is pass. You don't fall asleep.
